title: Sweet Korean BBQ Kimchi Cheeseburgers
changes_from_base: Grilled patties are brushed with a home-made sweet soy, sesame, garlic, ginger and pear glaze, then topped with American cheese, chopped kimchi, quick-pickled cucumber and carrot, and spring onion.
summary: Charred beef glazed with a sweet-savoury pear and soy sauce glistens under melted cheese, brought alive by tangy kimchi and crisp pickles.

ingredients.item: small cucumber, deseeded and cut into thin matchsticks
small carrot, peeled and cut into thin matchsticks
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
cabbage kimchi, chopped (check the label: no added alcohol)

steps.title: Pickle
steps.text: Toss 1 small cucumber (deseeded and cut into thin matchsticks), 1 small carrot (peeled and cut into thin matchsticks), 1 tsp fine salt, 1 tbsp caster sugar and 2 tbsp rice vinegar in a medium bowl and set aside.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Simmer 60 ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp light brown sugar, 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil, 2 finely grated garlic cloves, 10 g finely grated fresh ginger and 60 g finely grated ripe pear in a small pan for 3-4 min until slightly syrupy; cool.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide 510 g beef chuck mince into 4 and shape into patties about 1 cm wider than the buns, then season with ½ tsp fine salt and ¼ tsp ground black pepper.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Heat a barbecue with one hot side and one cooler side (or a griddle pan over high), grill patties over the hot side about 2 min until charred, flip, brush with glaze and cook 2 min more; flip again, move to the cooler side and keep brushing until 71 °C in the centre (about 4-6 min), then put a cheese slice on each.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast 4 burger buns cut side up on the hot side for about 30 s.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Place patties on bun bases, then 75 g chopped cabbage kimchi (checked for no added alcohol), 2 thinly sliced spring onions and drained pickles; drizzle with a little more glaze, close and serve.

tips: Make the pickle at least 30 minutes ahead for softened vegetables and flavour.
Brush the warm glaze onto hot patties for a glossy coating as it thickens.
Most shop kimchi contains fish sauce and salted shrimp; check the label for these, and for added alcohol
storage: Cooked patties can be refrigerated for 2 days; the glaze and pickle keep separately for 3-4 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
